title: Coordinate network mapping (Darby 2019)
differences_from_source: Coordinates (for example atrophy or activation peaks) become spherical seeds that are mapped by this library's engine; their maps are thresholded with the N-aware Bonferroni FWE rule instead of a fixed |T|.
Connectome QA chips (degree and PC1) are added.
description: Network mapping of heterogeneous neuroimaging coordinates: the overlap of the networks of coordinate seeds.
